title: Rideable Dolphins
description: This small mod adds the ability to ride & steer dolphins with no saddle.
body:
## What does this mod have?

It only has rideable dolphins which don't require a saddle to ride them.

## What versions are avaliable?

Forge 1.20.1+ (For now)

## Are there any dependecies?

This is a lightweight dolphin riding mod I've made, it doesn't depend on anything.
